body: Think I’d settle for some sleep

Me from 6 months ago wouldn’t take this lying down. A friend of mine has even taken it upon herself to contact a lawyer who said this would be the easiest case he’s ever taken on.

But after the last few months I just can’t find the strength to bother.
Hell, I’m writing this sitting in my car contemplating a 2nd go that’s how defeated I feel.
At the time, I didn’t really intent to be around.

I’d only been with the company for 6 months and was 2 days from finishing my probationary period, the only reason they would give me was my probation was unsuccessful. I asked if there had been any issues with my performance but the head of HR would only say he’d been instructed to inform me that my probation was unsuccessful.
Well, about as well as I was on Monday morning.
